title: 5G LI: Add dissector for 5G Lawful Interception
description:
- packet-li5g.c used to parse the LI x2/x3 PDU header which defined in ETSI TS 103 221-2
- lix2 used to parse the LI x2 xIRI payload, the ASN.1 defined in 3GPP 33.128
[client.key.pem](/uploads/52252ea5d309c9dbb4a5a0fd204c119a/client.key.pem)
[x2x3.pcap](/uploads/4a9670c464de7506af7140a159670489/x2x3.pcap)

notes.body: Maybe split out the TCP/reassembly part, which a clear description and/or test case?

Thanks, I had updated this merge request. Also upload a 5G LI "x2x3.pcap" with both x2 xIRI and x3 cc PDU and the RSA key file "client.key.pem" needed to decrypt the TLS(The 5G LI x2/x3 is encoded under TLS).
